TITLE:

DESCRIPTION:
Bollywood stars filmed for likes, but a Tiger Shroff shooting went viral. Shooters planned to flee to Delhi via Surat but missed the bus. Tiger Shroff shocked, no enmity. Firing case: two firearms, 10 live cartridges. #Bollywood #TigerShroff #Shooting #India
